title: Digital Arsenal
imageAlt: Computer monitor with code and UI mockups
author: Uday Hese
excerpt: A tour of projects that blend full-stack engineering and machine learning to build modern web experiences.
content: This post highlights my key projects, architecture choices, and lessons learned while building full-stack apps and AI tools. I cover design decisions, deployment strategies, and where I plan to take each project next.

title: FairShare: Split Wise Clone
imageAlt: Group expense UI shown on a mobile screen
author: Uday Hese
excerpt: Built a fully client-side app for group expense tracking using React and localStorage, with realtime UI sync via React Query.
content: FairShare demonstrates an offline-first approach, optimistic updates, and simple reconciliation logic for shared expenses.

title: Mental Health Chatbot
imageAlt: Chat interface on desktop showing empathetic messages
author: Uday Hese
excerpt: An empathetic AI assistant for mental health support using local PDF knowledge, Groq API, and offline LLM fallbacks.
content: This project explores safe fallback strategies and how to combine local documents with remote LLMs to create a privacy-first assistant.

title: Virtual Traffic Police
imageAlt: Traffic scene with bounding boxes around vehicles
author: Uday Hese
excerpt: Real-time vehicle detection using YOLOv10, OpenCV streaming, and FFmpeg integration for edge deployment.
content: This writeup covers model selection, video piping, and performance tradeoffs when deploying detection on resource-constrained hardware.

title: Book PM — Get Free Wax
author: Uday Hese
excerpt: Short promotional post about booking periodic maintenance and getting a free wax polish for showroom shine.
content: Campaign mechanics, how to claim the offer, and tips for scheduling your vehicle service online.
